```rst
Settings Reference
==================

This document describes the configuration settings for Project Quill.

accent_color
------------

- **Type**: Hex color string
- **Default**: ``#1A73E8``
- **Description**: The primary accent color used throughout the user interface.

cache_ttl
---------

- **Type**: Integer (seconds)
- **Default**: ``90``
- **Description**: The time-to-live value specifying how long a page remains cached before being refreshed.

retry_delay
-----------

- **Type**: Integer (seconds)
- **Default**: ``2``
- **Description**: The wait period before attempting to retry a failed synchronization operation.
```
